top_signals.title: How Trump’s Russian Diesel Could End Up in Cuba Instead
top_signals.summary: The tanker billed as the first to carry Russian diesel to the United States under Donald Trump’s deal with Vladimir Putin has dropped New York as its destination. The Malta-flagged Agioi Fanendes left Primorsk on October 22 with about 40,000 metric tons of ultra-low-sulfur diesel, due in New York on November 7. Lloyd’s List reported it idling off Skagen, Denmark, on October 26. Its tracking now shows “for orders,” meaning it has no declared port. top_signals.title: Legal powerhouse Weil Gotshal set to liquidate after 95 years
top_signals.summary: Weil, Gotshal and Manges has told its partners the firm should be wound down, in a move that will bring an end to one of the US’s most storied legal firms. top_signals.title: Sprouts Sinks After Outlook Cut on Cyclospora, Consumer Woes
top_signals.summary: Sprouts Farmers Market Inc. shares tumbled after slashing its outlook, as the grocer’s sales suffered from the cyclospora lettuce outbreak and a gloomy consumer.
